The bug in [`ExtendedMessageFormat`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_43_group_b_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormat.java#L417-L425) has been resolved.

### Cause of Bug
In `ExtendedMessageFormat.appendQuotedString(String, ParsePosition, StringBuffer, boolean)`, when parsing an escaped quote character with `escapingOn == true` and `c[start] == QUOTE`, the method returned without advancing the `ParsePosition` via `next(pos)`. Consequently, the parse position remained unchanged in the outer loop of `applyPattern`, resulting in an infinite loop and `OutOfMemoryError`.

### Fix
In [`ExtendedMessageFormat.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_43_group_b_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormat.java#L421-L424), added `next(pos);` before returning when `escapingOn && c[start] == QUOTE`.

### Verification
- Ran the original failing test: `org.apache.commons.lang.text.ExtendedMessageFormatTest::testEscapedQuote_LANG_477`
- Result: **Passed** (0 failing tests).
- Saved focused patch containing only the source code changes to [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_43_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
